overview: The paper theoretically and experimentally analyzes the expressive power of Graph Neural Networks for Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) using the Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) test, constructing indistinguishable SAT instances and evaluating WL-distinguishability on random and industrial benchmarks via an augmented formula checking method.

modules.name: CNF Parser & LCN Builder
modules.description: Parses SAT formulas in DIMACS CNF format and constructs the Literal-Clause Graph with Negation connections (LCN), differentiating edge colors for literal-clause and literal-literal (negation) relationships.

modules.name: Weisfeiler-Leman Algorithm Engine
modules.description: Implements the color refinement algorithm (1-WL) for edge-colored bipartite graphs, computing iterative node colorings until convergence to establish equivalence classes of literals.

modules.name: Augmented Formula Generator
modules.description: Constructs the augmented formula by adding equality constraints between all literals within the same WL equivalence class for a given round, outputting a new CNF formula to test WL expressivity limits.

modules.name: SAT Solver Interface
modules.description: Wraps an underlying SAT solver to check the satisfiability of the generated augmented formulas and residual formulas, returning the satisfiability status to determine the critical WL round.

modules.name: 3-Regular SAT Generator
modules.description: Implements the construction logic to generate 3-Regular SAT instances where each literal appears in exactly three clauses and each clause contains exactly three literals, as defined in Theorem 5.1.

modules.name: CFI Indistinguishable Instance Generator
modules.description: Implements the Cai-Fürer-Immerman (CFI) based construction to generate pairs of satisfiable and unsatisfiable 3-SAT instances that are provably indistinguishable by the n-WL test, as detailed in Theorem 5.3.

modules.name: Random LIG-based SAT Generator
modules.description: Generates random literal-incidence graphs and extracts corresponding CNF formulas via minimal clique edge covers, implementing the method used to analyze distinguishability in random SAT instances.

modules.name: Partial Assignment & Restart Simulator
modules.description: Simulates the sequential variable assignment process and restart strategies, applying partial assignments to the LCN and running WL to verify if residual formulas remain indistinguishable, testing the implications of Lemma 5.4.

modules.name: Dataset Management & Loader
modules.description: Handles the loading, filtering by size, and preprocessing of benchmark datasets, including random instances from the G4SAT benchmark and industrial/crafted instances from the International SAT Competition.

modules.name: Expressivity Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the main experimental workflow by iterating over instances, running the WL algorithm for increasing rounds, generating augmented formulas, checking satisfiability, and identifying the critical round or flagging unsolvable instances.

modules.name: Results Aggregation & Analysis
modules.description: Aggregates experimental results across different instance families and difficulties, computing statistics for the critical WL round and convergence round, and generating comparison tables for random versus industrial benchmarks.
